published_reference.note: Selected the best epoch by held-out AUC, so these are optimistic. Do not compare trial numbers against them directly.

measured_baseline.note: Default config scored through this framework with final-epoch metrics. These are the honest numbers a trial must beat. Best-epoch selection inflated the published LOSO mean by roughly 0.076 AUC.

screen.rationale: Matches the measured baseline (0.628). A cheap filter: an idea that cannot equal the baseline on random splits does not deserve a LOSO run.

loso-subset.rationale: Just above the measured subset baseline (0.659), so a candidate must show a real cross-site gain, not seed noise, before the full sweep.

loso-full.rationale: About 0.03 above the measured full-LOSO baseline (0.631). Clearing this is the only thing that justifies a new experiments/ directory.
